title: Reducing the Adaptation Gap Through Reachable Fisher Geometry
abstract: arXiv:2609.36329v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) determines not only how many parameters are trained, but also which local directions a model can move in, so similar adapters can affect subgroup losses differently. Since curvature matrices are infeasible to form at adapter scale, scalar summaries such as the Fisher trace are often used instead. We study what the trace reveals and what it loses through the reachable Fisher: each subgroup's full-model Fisher pulled back through the adapter Jacobian. Under likelihood losses, it represents the Gauss-Newton curvature accessible to the adapter, and its trace can be computed from score-gradient norms without forming the full matrix. Under matched subgroup gradients, a positive-definite reachable-Fisher difference, with a margin exceeding the Hessian-Fisher defect, implies that every sufficiently small nonzero model-changing update increases the signed gap. translated_title: 通过可达费希尔几何缩小适应差距
translated_abstract: 参数高效微调不仅决定了训练多少参数，还决定了模型能够沿哪些局部方向移动，因此看似相似的适配器可能对不同子群的损失产生不同的影响。由于在适配器规模上构造曲率矩阵并不可行，人们通常转而使用费希尔迹等标量摘要量。我们通过“可达费希尔”来研究迹究竟能揭示什么、又丢失了什么：它是每个子群的完整模型费希尔矩阵经由适配器雅可比矩阵拉回后的结果。在似然损失下，它表示适配器所能触及的高斯-牛顿曲率，且其迹可以由得分梯度范数计算得到，而无需构造完整矩阵。在子群梯度匹配的条件下，若可达费希尔之差为正定、且其裕度超过海森-费希尔缺陷，则每一个足够小的非零改变模型的更新都会增大带符号的差距。相比之下，受限算子范数则确定……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出“可达费希尔”几何框架，通过适配器雅可比矩阵拉回的子群全模型费希尔曲率，为参数高效微调中何时任意微小更新必然扩大子群间适应差距给出了可计算的判别条件。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the "reachable Fisher" geometry—each subgroup's full-model Fisher pulled back through the adapter Jacobian—to provide a computable, trace-based criterion (a positive-definite reachable-Fisher difference exceeding the Hessian-Fisher defect) for when any sufficiently small model-changing update must increase the subgroup adaptation gap in parameter-efficient fine-tuning.
